long_biography.plain_text:
Van Es established the business that became Dieseko Holding, initially developing and supplying hydraulic vibratory hammers and power packs for foundation work. His initials formed the PVE brand. The company grew around specialist engineering, equipment rental and international operations, while he also worked on patented conveyor systems for high-wall mining and helped adapt heavy machinery for commercial use.

The wider Van Es Group expanded into crawler cranes, jack-up platforms, offshore drilling, work barges and marine logistics. Its companies have supported energy, civil-construction, salvage and decommissioning projects across international markets. After NPM Capital acquired a majority stake in Dieseko, van Es joined its supervisory board, contributing founder knowledge and experience in product development and diversification.
